name: The Week Ender
blurb: A coach's Friday text message, made into an app. Answer three questions on Thursday night, get an hour-by-hour plan for the weekend on Friday morning. A rough week earns a looser plan, not a stricter one.

name: Cabin Notes
blurb: For people who own a seasonal cabin they do not rent out. Photo inventory, a running bring-list, the closing and opening checklist, and a guest guide you can text. Every part of it works in airplane mode.

name: Footsteps of the Teacher
blurb: Kids learn to write real code by building the Bible stories they already know by heart. Type a line, the donkey appears. Ada the owl catches typos, guesses what you meant, and never scolds.

name: Strongman Contest
blurb: Run a contest from one phone with no internet, because gyms are basements. Place-point scoring done properly — an event win is worth N points for N entrants, ties split the pooled slots, and holds sort the opposite way to medleys.

name: Season Book
blurb: A gymnast's meet scores across a whole season, on a parent's own iCloud. Women's four apparatus or men's six, personal bests, and a wall display for the gym television.

name: Two or Three
blurb: One topic, everyone at the table, and each person asked the version of the question that fits where they actually are — a six-year-old and a fourteen-year-old get different questions about the same thing. Ten minutes, then the phone goes face down. Free, with no ads and nothing to buy.

name: Spotter
blurb: A gym CRM for one person running the whole place themselves. Clients, sessions and payments on your own iCloud. No server, no monthly fee.

name: BizLedger
blurb: A bookkeeping app for people who do not want a bookkeeping app. Income, expenses and mileage in seconds. No bank connection, no reconciliation, no chart of accounts.

name: Polly
blurb: Every voice deserves to be remembered. Polly started as a way to ask where you put something and be told the answer — and turned into something larger about holding on to what a family knows before it is gone. Works with no internet at all.

name: Workout Tracker
blurb: Your coach writes the program, you log it on your phone set by set. Travel workouts for when you are away, a pain-and-injury video library, and a belt system for when you want to test what you have got. Free for anyone who wants to train — ask me for a code.
